dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、面会だぞ」
dialogues.en: "Hey Asakura, someone's here to see you."
dialogues.text: "Hey Asakura, someone's here to see you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
杉並に言われて教室の入口を見ると、萌先輩が
立っていた。
dialogues.en:
When I looked at the entrance of the classroom, Moe-sempai
was standing there.
dialogues.text:
When I looked at the entrance of the classroom, Moe-sempai
was standing there.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんです？」
dialogues.en: "Did you need me?"
dialogues.text: "Did you need me?"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩を教室に招きいれ、自分の席に座りなが
ら先輩を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
I invited her into the classroom and looked up at her from
my chair.
dialogues.text:
I invited her into the classroom and looked up at her from
my chair.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「一緒に食べようと思って、お昼のお弁当を持っ
　てきたんです」
dialogues.en: "I brought you some lunch so we can eat together."
dialogues.text: "I brought you some lunch so we can eat together."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「お弁当？」
dialogues.en: "Lunch?"
dialogues.text: "Lunch?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はい。朝倉くんが屋上に上るのは大変なので、
　食堂に行かなくても大丈夫なように作ったん
　です」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. It's difficult for you to come up to the rooftop or go
to the cafeteria, so I made you some lunch."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. It's difficult for you to come up to the rooftop or go
to the cafeteria, so I made you some lunch."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、俺の机に四角い包みが置かれる。
dialogues.en:
Saying that, she placed a square container wrapped in a
cloth on my desk.
dialogues.text:
Saying that, she placed a square container wrapped in a
cloth on my desk.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なかなか気が利くメイドさんじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "She's a pretty nice maid!"
dialogues.text: "She's a pretty nice maid!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「メイドさんじゃない。先輩だ」
dialogues.en: "She's not my maid. She's my friend."
dialogues.text: "She's not my maid. She's my friend."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おお、そうか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see."

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩が包みを解くと、デカイ弁当箱が現れた。
dialogues.en: When she opened the cloth, a huge lunch box appeared.
dialogues.text: When she opened the cloth, a huge lunch box appeared.

dialogues.jp: 「大きいですね」
dialogues.en: "It's huge."
dialogues.text: "It's huge."

dialogues.jp: ２〜３人分は入ってるんじゃないか？
dialogues.en: It should contain 2 to 3 servings.
dialogues.text: It should contain 2 to 3 servings.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はい。足りないといけないので、すこし多め
　に作ってきました」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I wanted to make sure I brought enough."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I wanted to make sure I brought enough."

dialogues.jp: これで少し多めなのだろうか？
dialogues.en: I think this is more than enough......
dialogues.text: I think this is more than enough......

dialogues.jp:
先輩が｛ふた／蓋｝をあけると、見栄えのするおかずがギッ
シリと並んでいた。
dialogues.en:
When she opened the lid, I saw the colorful foods were
packed inside of the box.
dialogues.text:
When she opened the lid, I saw the colorful foods were
packed inside of the box.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どれが食べたいですか？」
dialogues.en: "Which one would you like to eat?"
dialogues.text: "Which one would you like to eat?"

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩が箸を持って、にこやかに聞いてくる。
dialogues.en: Moe held the chopsticks and asked me softly.
dialogues.text: Moe held the chopsticks and asked me softly.

dialogues.jp: 「え？　いや、卵焼きですが、箸を……」
dialogues.en:
"What? Well, I want some omelets, so can you pass me the
chopsticks......"
dialogues.text:
"What? Well, I want some omelets, so can you pass me the
chopsticks......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「卵焼きですね」
dialogues.en: "You want some omelets?"
dialogues.text: "You want some omelets?"

dialogues.jp: ニッコリ微笑んで萌先輩が卵焼きを箸でつまむ。
dialogues.en:
She smiled softly and picked up a piece of omelet with her
chopsticks.
dialogues.text:
She smiled softly and picked up a piece of omelet with her
chopsticks.

dialogues.jp: そしてそのまま、俺の口の前に差し出される。
dialogues.en: Then she brought it in front of my mouth.
dialogues.text: Then she brought it in front of my mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩は、卵焼きを俺の口元に差し出したまま、
きょとんとして俺を見つめる。
dialogues.en:
Moe kept holding her chopsticks in front of my mouth and
stared at me with a surprised face.
dialogues.text:
Moe kept holding her chopsticks in front of my mouth and
stared at me with a surprised face.

dialogues.jp: 「なんですか、これは？」
dialogues.en: "What are you trying to do?"
dialogues.text: "What are you trying to do?"

dialogues.jp: もしかして、ここで『あ〜ん』ですか？
dialogues.en: Is she trying to feed me in front of everybody?
dialogues.text: Is she trying to feed me in front of everybody?

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「恋人とお弁当といったら、お口に『あ〜ん』
　です」
dialogues.en: "This is what boyfriends and girlfriends do, right?"
dialogues.text: "This is what boyfriends and girlfriends do, right?"

dialogues.jp:
誰か、この人の思いっきり勘違いした知識を矯
正してくれ。
dialogues.en: Someone needs to tighten up her loose nuts and bolts.
dialogues.text: Someone needs to tighten up her loose nuts and bolts.

dialogues.jp:
なおかつ、俺達は別に、恋人同士じゃないと思
うのだが……。
dialogues.en:
In addition, I don't think we're boyfriend and
girlfriend......
dialogues.text:
In addition, I don't think we're boyfriend and
girlfriend......

dialogues.jp: 「あの……萌先輩」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「恋人同士でも、普通に食べていいんですよ」
dialogues.en: "A boyfriend and a girlfriend don't have to do this."
dialogues.text: "A boyfriend and a girlfriend don't have to do this."

dialogues.jp: ましてや、ただの先輩と後輩の関係なら。
dialogues.en:
Also if you're just friends, you absolutely wouldn't do
this.
dialogues.text:
Also if you're just friends, you absolutely wouldn't do
this.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that true?"
dialogues.text: "Is that true?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ええ。あの、だから……自分で食べますんで、
　箸をもらえますか？」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I'll eat on my own, so can you pass me the chopsticks
please......?"
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I'll eat on my own, so can you pass me the chopsticks
please......?"

dialogues.jp: ここで『あ〜ん』は、きつすぎる。
dialogues.en: I can't let her feed me in the classroom.
dialogues.text: I can't let her feed me in the classroom.

dialogues.jp: すでにかなりの視線に串刺しにされている。
dialogues.en: I can feel people staring already.
dialogues.text: I can feel people staring already.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「困りました……」
dialogues.en: "That's not good......"
dialogues.text: "That's not good......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんです？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.jp: なぜか困惑げな萌先輩に不安を覚える。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai showed a concerned face for some reason.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai showed a concerned face for some reason.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい。お箸、これしか持ってきてな
　いんです」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry. This is the only set of chopsticks I brought."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry. This is the only set of chopsticks I brought."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい……必要ないと思っていたもの
　ですから……本当にごめんなさいです」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry...... I didn't think I needed more...... I'm
really sorry."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry...... I didn't think I needed more...... I'm
really sorry."

dialogues.jp: お弁当に顔を突っ込みそうなほど、頭を下げる。
dialogues.en:
She bowed deeply as if she was sticking her head into the
lunch box.
dialogues.text:
She bowed deeply as if she was sticking her head into the
lunch box.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「これは間接キスしかあるまい」
dialogues.en: "You have to share the chopsticks with her then."
dialogues.text: "You have to share the chopsticks with her then."

dialogues.jp: いままで沈黙していた杉並の声が耳にとどく。
dialogues.en: Suginami's comment came unbidden to my ears.
dialogues.text: Suginami's comment came unbidden to my ears.

dialogues.jp: どうやらファイナルアンサーが出たようだ……。
dialogues.en: I guess that's the final answer......
dialogues.text: I guess that's the final answer......

dialogues.jp: 俺は瞳を閉じ、口を開放した。
dialogues.en: I closed my eyes and opened my mouth.
dialogues.text: I closed my eyes and opened my mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「あ〜ん」
◆萌先輩のお弁当◆
dialogues.en: ◆Moe-sempai's homemade lunch◆
dialogues.text: ◆Moe-sempai's homemade lunch◆

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩がお弁当を持って、やって来てくれた。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai brought some lunch for me.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai brought some lunch for me.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩によれば、恋人同士は、“あ〜ん”で食
べるのだそうだ。
dialogues.en:
According to her, a girlfriend's supposed to feed her
boyfriend.
dialogues.text:
According to her, a girlfriend's supposed to feed her
boyfriend.
